description: A company profile from its domain, read live from its own site: what it sells and to whom, pricing and plans, NAICS sector, self-reported head count band, open roles from its Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby board, tech stack, socials, security.txt role contacts, and the domain's registrar, age, email provider, SaaS vendors and SPF/DMARC posture. Each AI-read field names its source page; coverage flags show what was found. Price: $0.05 (70% off when served from cache)

cache.description: Serve a cached copy when one exists (cached responses are 70% off)

cacheTtl.description: How long to cache this response, in seconds

domain.description: The company's website domain, e.g. "vercel.com". A full URL is accepted and reduced to its hostname.

name: company_profile
